Context: Educationally Backward Classes (OBCs)

- Order 1-A, Section 3.  
3. (a) Certificate.Any candidate claiming to belong to the OBC should obtain a certificate in the prescribed form signed by any of the specified authorities. No other certificate will be accepted. The authority should also certify that the candidate does not belong to any one of the Creamy Layers.
